description: This file provides implementations for mapping functions over various collection types, specifically for use within the Torch FX framework. It defines functions map_arg and map_aggregate which recursively apply a function to Nodes or other data structures in a computational graph context, utilizing immutable collections from torch.fx.immutable_collections.

methods.name: Any map_arg(a: Any, fn: Callable[[Node], Any])
methods.description: Applies a given function to a Node within an argument, utilizing substitute_in_graph decorator for graph substitution and possibly constant folding.

methods.name: Any map_aggregate(a: Any, fn: Callable[[Any], Any])
methods.description: Recursively applies a function to elements of various data structures (tuples, lists, dicts, slices) and supports NamedTuples by reconstructing their types.

ctags.name: map_aggregate
ctags.pattern: /^def map_aggregate(a: Any, fn: Callable[[Any], Any]) -> Any:$/

ctags.name: map_arg
ctags.pattern: /^def map_arg(a: Any, fn: Callable[[Node], Any]) -> Any:$/
